content_blocks.section: Aegis Series-7 Hydraulic Control System — Operator Manual

content_blocks.text: 1. Overview

The Aegis Series-7 Hydraulic Control System provides closed-loop hydraulic pressure regulation
for industrial press lines. The system is built around the Hydraulic Power Pack, which supplies
pressurized fluid to the press circuit under the supervision of the Aegis Controller.
2. Key Components
4. Starting the Hydraulic Power Pack
Before starting, verify:
Hydraulic fluid level is within the normal band.
Isolation valve IV-21 is open.
Emergency stop is reset.
WARNING:Do not start the unit with the maintenance access panel removed.
1. Turn the POWER selector to ON.
2. Press START.
3. Verify pressure reaches180 bar.
5. Normal Operating Ranges
Normal HPU discharge pressure is 180 bar, as measured by pressure sensor PS-04.
6. Alarms
See the Aegis Alarm Reference for alarm A17 (Hydraulic Pressure Low) and related codes.

This legacy export does not reflect ECN-1042 (PS-04 to PS-04A sensor change and pressure setpoint
update to 200 bar, effective software revision 3.2) or ECN-1058. Do not use this document as the
sole reference for units running software revision 3.2 or later.
